noLocations: No dynamic locations. Using system defaults.

approvalMatrixHint: Configure exception rules. By default, leaves go to line managers first.

esocialEmployerHint: CNPJ and environment used for pre-payroll and eSocial exports.
esocialRubricsHint: Rubric codes for export and S-1200 XML (per current eSocial table).
ptrpPolicyHint: Hour bank, timesheet period, and default break settings for PTRP compliance.
clockStartDateHint: Date the time clock started recording punches. Days before it do not generate absences nor debit the bank (no data was collected). Leave empty if the clock has always run.
bankEnabledDesc: Sets where every employee's overtime goes. This is the master switch — it applies to all shifts.
bankEnabledOnHint: Enabled: overtime becomes a bank credit (usable as time off) and absences debit the balance.
bankEnabledOffHint: Disabled: overtime is paid on payroll (OT 50%/100%). The current bank balance is frozen and stays visible as history, with no new entries.
overtimeToBankMovedHint: Overtime destination (hour bank or payroll payment) is now set centrally in System → PTRP Policy → "Hour bank enabled".
periodStartDayHint: E.g. 26 = cycle from the 26th to the 25th (payroll closes on the 25th). Use 1 for calendar month.
weeklyOtThresholdHint: Minutes worked per week before counting as overtime (e.g. 2400 = 40 h).
defaultBreakHint: Default intraday break duration used in workday calculations.
breakFixedHint: Uncheck to set a fixed break window (start and end). Duration in minutes is calculated automatically.
breakFixedWindowRequired: Enter break start and end (end must be after start).
daySchedulesHint: Set different hours for specific weekdays (e.g. Saturday half-day).
dutyTypeLabelsHint: Customize the display names for your two duty types. Internal values remain unchanged.
logoSizeError: Logo file size must be less than 2MB.
logoTypeError: Logo must be an image file.
enabledNotificationTypesHint: Control which notification types are active for your organization

clockSupervisors.title: Clock supervisors
clockSupervisors.description: Build the PrintPoint supervisor list. Saving here does not change the clock; transmission is a separate action under General Changes.
clockSupervisors.name: Name
clockSupervisors.passwordHint: Use exactly 6 digits. The password is encrypted and is never displayed again.
clockSupervisors.codeInvalid: Enter a numeric code with up to 20 digits.
clockSupervisors.limitReached: PrintPoint accepts up to 5 active supervisors.

clockComm.title: IP Communication · General Changes
clockComm.description: DMP REP-equivalent commands for PrintPoint at 192.168.15.201:3000.
clockComm.sharedChannel: Punch collection and these commands share the same TCP channel. Other operations are locked while one is running.
clockComm.sendDescription: Sends the complete active supervisor list stored in HR. It does not clear the clock automatically.
clockComm.clearDescription: Removes every supervisor currently stored on the clock.
clockComm.recoveryFlow: Recommended recovery: Clear Supervisors → add the new password supervisor → Send Supervisors → test F1, function 91, code and password.
clockComm.sendConfirmText: The active supervisors below will be sent to the clock.
clockComm.clearConfirmText: This command acts immediately on the clock and does not delete records stored in HR.
clockComm.clearWarning: Warning: every device master will be removed. Send a new supervisor immediately after clearing so the clock is not left without administrative access.
clockComm.sendFailed: Could not send supervisors to the clock.
clockComm.clearFailed: Could not clear supervisors from the clock.
clockComm.busy: The clock channel is busy. Wait for the current operation to finish.

dmprepSync.title: Clock sync
dmprepSync.description: Records: HR exports to DIMEP.MDB (PC .69). Punches: automatic collection from PrintPoint SmartPoint B via TCP on the HR server.
dmprepSync.autoSyncDetail: Automatic collect at 09:00, 15:00 and 19:00 (WatchComm on HR server .245 → clock 192.168.15.201 → timesheet). Outside those times use “Collect punches”. Records come from RH export — no need to register in DMP REP.
dmprepSync.note: Biometrics are enrolled and deleted on the physical clock (functions 91 and 92). Discharging in HR removes the PrintPoint record but not fingerprints — delete on clock first.
dmprepSync.syncAllHint: Import legacy records (MDB → HR) + collect punches. New admission: use HR wizard + export, not this button.
dmprepSync.syncEmployeesHint: DIMEP.MDB → Team Directory (legacy flow). HR-first admission: use wizard and Send to DMPREP on the employee.
dmprepSync.syncPunchesHint: Immediate collect from PrintPoint clock (TCP) → timesheet. Does not create new employees. Automatic collection runs at 09:00, 15:00 and 19:00.
dmprepSync.serviceDown: dmprep-sync service is unreachable. Wait a few seconds and retry (auto-restart). If it persists, run start-rh.ps1.
dmprepSync.busy: A sync is already running. Try again shortly.
dmprepSync.readOnly: Subscription expired: sync is unavailable in read-only mode.
dmprepSync.punchesSkippedWarning: {{count}} punch(es) skipped — no employee in HR: {{ids}}
